test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Identify the errors in the given sentence and choose the sentence that rectifies these errors.

I have known her for many years. This time, she took unusual decision in unprejudiced way.

options.text: I have known her for many years. This time, she took a unusual decision in an unprejudiced way.
I have known her for many years. This time, she took unusual decision in an unprejudiced way.
I have known her for many years. This time, she took an unusual decision in an unprejudiced way.
I have known her for many years. This time, she took an unusual decision in a unprejudiced way.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the omission of the article **"an"** before the term **"unusual decision"** and **"****unprejudiced way"**
 
• Singular countable nouns typically require an article ("a" or "an").
 
• The correct phrase should be "**an unusual decision**," and **"an ****unprejudiced way"** ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I have known her for many years. This time, she took **an unusual decision** in **an unprejudiced way."***
